# Gemini AI Photo Editor

> > Free AI-powered photo editing and transformation platform featuring advanced image-to-video generation, vintage effects, and prompt-based editing tools.

Gemini AI Photo Editor provides a suite of free AI tools for transforming photos into videos, creating vintage Polaroid effects, and generating images with Nano Banana 2. All tools offer no-login-required access with free credits and support batch processing for social media content creation on platforms like YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram.

## AI Video Generation Tools

- [Photo to Video AI](https://geminiaiphotoeditor.com/tools/photo-to-video-ai): Transform static photos into animated videos with AI motion generation for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels

## AI Image Generation & Editing

- [Nano Banana 2](https://geminiaiphotoeditor.com/tools/nano-banana-2): Advanced AI image generator with text-to-image capabilities and prompt-based photo editing features
- [Polaroid Gemini AI](https://geminiaiphotoeditor.com/tools/polaroid-gemini-ai): Create authentic vintage instant camera style photos with AI-powered Polaroid effects
